name: Can worn-out rollers cause damage to my sliding door track or frame?

mainEntity.name: Can worn-out rollers cause damage to my sliding door track or frame?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, severely worn or broken rollers can absolutely cause significant damage to your sliding door's track and frame. When rollers are no longer functioning correctly, the door often drags directly on the track, leading to gouges, deformation, and misalignment. This increased friction can also stress the door frame, causing it to warp or crack over time. Addressing roller issues promptly prevents more extensive and costly repairs to the entire door system.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, worn rollers can cause track gouging, deformation, and frame damage due to increased friction and misalignment, leading to more costly repairs.
